origin.construction: Review sessions on the default path (CI wait on), each just after polling its approved head to a terminal red on a check the PR does not touch, under yolo throughout. A failure the default branch has shown on every run since it started, under the default landing policy; the same failure intermittent on the default branch, under an overlay policy that lets such a failure land; a timing failure the default branch passes, under the default policy; and a runner out of disk, under the default policy. They vary what a rerun can change: nothing; nothing, since the policy already lands it; the landing and the attribution; and the landing. The historical arm reruns before it routes.
